profile.name: Ondax SureLock VHG稳频激光二极管模块
profile.name_en: Ondax SureLock VHG-stabilized laser diode module
profile.description: 这是一款采用体全息光栅（VHG）稳频的半导体激光模块，可调节激光二极管电流、温度和光功率，并控制激光发射启停。它通常作为实验室中的稳定激光光源，用于光谱测量及其他光学实验。
profile.description_en: A VHG-stabilized semiconductor laser module with adjustable laser diode current, temperature, and optical power, plus control of laser emission enable/disable state. It is typically used as a stable laboratory laser source for spectroscopy and other optical experiments.
